glance.headline: Anthropic starts trading on Nasdaq at $111.50 share price
glance.teaser: Anthropic officially goes public on Nasdaq
glance.summary: Anthropic has officially gone public under ticker symbol "ANT" at $111.50 per share. The listing comes nearly a month after Anthropic revealed its plans to go public.
glance.why: The public listing puts the company's value at around $1.5 trillion after shares climbed to $111.50.

explain.kid: Anthropic put its stock on Wall Street for people to buy. Its value reached around $1.5 trillion!
explain.pm: Anthropic listed on the Nasdaq under ticker symbol "ANT" at $111.50 per share, up from its initial $83 price that valued the company at around $1.5 trillion.
explain.engineer: Anthropic went public on the Nasdaq under symbol "ANT" at $111.50 per share, up from its initial $83 per share price.

big_pour.summary: Google's Gemini app for macOS now supports computer use. The feature helps complete multi-step tasks across local files, desktop apps, and the web.

office_blend.teaser: BMW governs hundreds of AI agents
office_blend.summary: The BMW Group shared practices used by its R&D teams to govern hundreds of AI agents across thousands of developers without sacrificing compliance.

still_roasting.summary: Meta has not denied reports that its upcoming Muse Charm AI wearable device may cost $300.

stories.headline: Vercel launches message board for AI agent collaboration

stories.label: Security research
stories.headline: OpenAI spends $1.2M finding Linux security flaws
stories.summary: OpenAI spent around $1.2 million in API costs generating working exploits for 948 Linux kernel vulnerabilities.

long_read.headline: Software factories and code reviews with Harjot Gill
long_read.summary: The newsletter shares why CodeRabbit CEO Harjot Gill believes human code review is dead, following his team shipping over 5,000 pull requests in a month.
